data.exact_reserve_text: During 2022, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2020 and prior) increased by $95.6m due to strengthening of Syndicate 1919 reserves on long tail classes, following a review of the assumptions underlying IBNR estimates during the year. On a net basis ultimate claims have reduced by $162.7m due to the LPT that is discussed in more detail on page 5.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer to Starr Insurance and Reinsurance Limited (SIRL)
prior_year_events.impact_description: LPT ceded the 2020 and prior years of account on certain classes; premium ceded $215.2m and the reinsurers' share of the change in provisions for claims includes the recoveries due on the business reinsured under the agreement. The LPT operated on a funds withheld basis and materially affected net recoverables and net prior year development.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross ultimate claims for prior underwriting years (2020 and prior) strengthened by $95.6m in 2022 following a review and uplift to IBNR assumptions affecting long-tail business (notably casualty/third-party liability and similar long-tail classes). This gross deterioration was partially offset on a net basis by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) to a group reinsurer which reduced net ultimate claims by $162.7m. The movements reflect both recalibration of IBNR and broader inflationary/claims-cost pressures on older years.
raw_causal_phrases: increased by $95.6m due to strengthening of Syndicate 1919 reserves on long tail classes, following a review of the assumptions underlying IBNR estimates during the year.
On a net basis ultimate claims have reduced by $162.7m due to the LPT that is discussed in more detail on page 5.

Adverse prior year development on longer tail classes (on 2017 and prior underwriting years) and the risk premium associated with the LPT are the material drivers for the underwriting loss during the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from the reported thousands into millions. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet (liabilities) prior-year column. Prior year development (gross) taken from an explicit narrative sentence (page 49) stating a $95.6m increase for 2020 and prior underwriting years. The LPT produced a quantified net reduction ($162.7m) but the gross reserve movement is reported as +$95.6m. Allocation of the PYD to specific LOBs is inferred (long-tail classes / casualty) and not explicitly quantified by LOB in the report.
